message: comment is required at Raise -- minimum: what the item is about
short_description must pass the title-shape check (escalation #759)
next_action='approved' requires resolution to be filled in (plan v3 sec3)
next_action='reject' requires state='withdraw' or 'supersede', chosen explicitly
tried is required when Claude sets next_action=revise on its own item -- describe what was attempted and why it didn't resolve it
next_action='ready_for_approval' requires resolution to be filled in -- the readiness check, re-confirmed at 'approved' (D25).
an update carrying comment/context/tried cannot leave the item at state='raised' -- move it off raised first (e.g. -State in-progress) before attaching work (D26).
resolution_kind is required at Raise -- decision_required or self_correctable (cfg_enum resolution_kind). See cfg_behaviour_rule 'decision-points-are-terminal-not-inline'.
decision_required items must pass through ready_for_approval before approved -- no shortcut, regardless of who is setting it (escalation #851/#865)

decision_required items must pass through ready_for_approval before noted -- no shortcut (escalation #851: noted reaches the same closed state as approved but previously had zero requirement checking at all)
